# Anvesh Gupta — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Anvesh Gupta, a full-stack (MERN) developer based in Jaipur, India,
> focused on distributed, algorithmically-optimized backend systems and competitive programming.

Static Astro site with React islands. All personal data lives in a single file, `src/config.ts`.

## Projects

- [Algorithmic Tournament & Fixture Engine](https://github.com/anvesh-04/tournament-engine): MERN app generating conflict-free round-robin fixtures with Graph Coloring and valid knockout brackets with Kahn's Algorithm. [Live demo](https://tournament-engine-eight.vercel.app/)
- [Distributed Rate Limiter Middleware](https://github.com/anvesh-04/mern-rate-limiter): framework-agnostic Node.js middleware with Token Bucket, Sliding Window Counter/Log and Fixed Window strategies over an atomic Redis + Lua storage layer.
